title: Chapter 407 - 407 Return; Yadi Automobile! (2)
content:
Chapter 407 - 407 Return; Yadi Automobile! (2)

Chapter 407 - 407 Return; Yadi Automobile! (2)

407 Return; Yadi Automobile! (2)

“Even though we’re only a few months into this year, I can say that Ling Rou is the most popular singer of the year!”

“Congratulations, Ling Rou!”

After the female host finished speaking, the audience burst into applause again.

At this moment, the male host said, “Next up, let’s invite our Heavenly Queen, Ni Min, to present the award to the winner of the Golden Melody Best Newcomer Award, Ling Rou!”

The applause became even more enthusiastic.

Some people applauded because of Ni Min’s identity.

They really liked Ni Min’s songs.

Even though Ni Min had not released a new song for several years, the songs that she had released in the past were still sung by many people and were liked by many.

It could be said that more than half of the people present were Ni Min’s fans.

Ni Min came to the stage and handed over a shiny trophy.

“Thank you, Sister Ni Min,” Ling Rou said happily.

What could be happier than her idol giving her an award?

“You deserve it,” Ni Min said with a smile.

The two of them stood together and spoke softly. Their faces were filled with smiles.

Countless flashes of light gathered on the two of them, making them extremely beautiful.

“Sister Ni Min, do you have anything to say to Ling Rou?” The female host handed over the microphone.

“A few months ago, when I accidentally heard songs like Galaxy, Three Lives, and The World of Man, I was immediately attracted by Ling Rou’s singing.

“At that time, I lamented that it had been a long time since a singer with such superb singing skills appeared in the music industry!

“Now, I’m not surprised to see her win the Golden Melody Best Newcomer Award because she deserves it!”

The venue once again erupted in warm applause.

They had never heard Ni Min praise a singer like this before.

Those who liked Ni Min also started to like Ling Rou!

Those who liked her became even prouder of her!

“Thank you, Sister Ni Min,” Ling Rou said excitedly.

When Ni Min and Ling Rou were about to walk down the stage, the two hosts stopped them.

“Sister Ni Min, Ling Rou, please wait a moment.” The male host laughed.

“Yes, I have to delay you for a little longer.”

The female host cleared her throat and said, “Next, we will present the most important award of the day! The winner of the Golden Melody Award is… Ling Rou’s Galaxy!”

One person won two awards.

Moreover, they were the two most important awards.

The crowd burst into applause again.

“Sister Ni Min, please present the award to Ling Rou.”

Ni Min picked up another transparent trophy and handed it to Ling Rou. She then picked up the microphone and said, “I just want to say that with Ling Rou’s singing, it’s only right for her to win these awards!

“In addition, these two awards are definitely not Ling Rou’s end but her starting point!”

“Thank you, Sister Ni Min,” Ling Rou said with a trembling voice.

She held the two trophies in her hands, and her eyes that were shining with starlight landed on Lin Fan.

She understood that the reason why she was able to win these awards was all because of Lin Fan.

…

In the audience.

Dai Jiexi’s entire face was red and swollen. She looked at Ling Rou on stage and could not help but cry.

These awards were originally hers!

Now, there was nothing left. There was nothing left!

At this moment, Dai Jiexi’s phone vibrated slightly.

A piece of news popped up.

[Dai Jiexi’s relationship exposed. She’s dating three people at the same time!]

One by one, photos of Dai Jiexi holding hands with different men as they entered the hotel, as well as their intimate actions, appeared on the internet.

Seeing this…

Dai Jiexi’s phone fell to the ground.

It was over!

She was really finished!

After the Golden Melody Awards, Lin Fan and Ling Rou stayed in Hong Kong for a few more days before taking a private plane back to Jiangbei.

The next day, the sky was clear.

Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly.

He looked at his phone. A text message had appeared on the screen as usual.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,542,900 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, he turned his attention to the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 20% of Yadi’s shares.]

“20% of Yadi’s shares?” Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

A few years ago, Yadi was only a relatively low-end automobile company.

However, with the vigorous development of new energy vehicles in recent years, Yadi had gradually become a top automobile company domestically and even internationally, with a market value of nearly 800 billion yuan!

20% of the shares was about 150 billion yuan!

Lin Fan nodded and muttered, “Today’s sign-in is not bad.”

He yawned and slowly got up from the bed.

After washing up, he leisurely ate his delicious breakfast.

While he was relaxing, Wang Fugui, the chairman of Yadi Automobile, was uneasy.

That was because Wang Fugui had discovered that 20% of Yadi Automobile’s shares had been acquired by someone else!

One had to know…

As the chairman and founder, he only had 24% of the shares.

As long as the other party bought more, they would be able to surpass him!

At that time, would Yadi Automobile still belong to him?

Wang Fugui sat on the soft executive chair and sighed. “Lin Fan is so young… Who exactly is he?”

Wang Fugui took out a stack of documents. After hesitating for a long time, he finally dialed the number according to the shareholder’s information.

After a while, the call went through.

Wang Fugui said in a slightly nervous voice, “Excuse me, are you Mr. Lin Fan?”

…

At this moment, Lin Fan had just finished his breakfast. He wiped the grease off the corner of his mouth and said, “Yes, who are you?”

“Mr. Lin, I’m the chairman of Yadi Automobile, Wang Fugui,” Wang Fugui said.

“Oh, Chairman Wang, hello,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Fan had received calls like this many times.

Therefore, it was not too surprising.

“I know that you’ve bought 20% of our shares,” Wang Fugui said. “First of all, thank you very much for your trust in us!

“In addition, I will now give a simple explanation of the future development direction of our Yadi Automobile. If you have any suggestions or opinions, you can let me know. In the future, we’ll firmly develop battery-powered new energy vehicles and…”

However, before he could finish, Lin Fan said, “You don’t have to tell me this. The reason why I bought your shares is because I trust you. You…”

As Lin Fan said this, he suddenly stopped.

That was because a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Mission: Watch a battery experiment, read The Safety Analysis of Electric Vehicle Power Batteries, The Engineering of Batteries, The Technology Basics of Electric Vehicles, The Powertrain of Electric Vehicles, and The Theory of Vehicle Batteries. Reward: One ultra-speed battery, as well as its detailed research and development data, principles, etc., and your chemistry experience will be upgraded.]

When Wang Fugui heard the first half of Lin Fan’s words, he was so happy that he could not control himself.

Lin Fan did not want to listen to him talk about the development direction of Yadi Automobile because he trusted him.

In that case, he would not interfere with the management of the company!

This was definitely good news!

That was because if that was the case, Lin Fan would be no different from a normal small shareholder. He would only receive a fixed amount of dividends.

Just as Wang Fugui was overjoyed, Lin Fan said, “About the development of new energy vehicles, I’ll call you later.”

After that, Lin Fan hung up the phone.

Wang Fugui was the only one left holding his phone in a daze.

What was going on?

Did he not say that he believed in him?

Was he going to interfere with the company’s new energy development?

Wang Fugui heaved a long sigh and got up to look at the vast scenery outside the window. He muttered, “What should I do?”
